claim: Current MCP acceptance should end in an authenticated initialize/session handshake.
counterevidence: MCP 2026-07-28 retired initialize/initialized and protocol sessions.
resolution: Update canon/tests to current spec; preserve historical claim as superseded.

claim: React/Vite atlas-shell is current/final live UI direction.
counterevidence: ADR-085 archives prior UI and current branch contains Flutter Mission Console.
resolution: Ensure CI/docs no longer treat archived shell as live product.

claim: Atlas has no desktop app.
counterevidence: Current branch contains Linux Flutter Mission Console.
resolution: Distinguish partial Mission Console from final Atlas product.

claim: Gmail connector does not exist.
counterevidence: ADR-065/current branch contains Gmail read-only connector path.
resolution: State read-only connector exists; do not overclaim full personal data ingestion.

claim: Osmosis Filter does not exist at all.
counterevidence: OSM-000/ADR-084 and gateway work show membrane slices; universal no-bypass enforcement is not proven.
resolution: Classify as PARTIAL, not MISSING or COMPLETE.

claim: F2.6 6/6 proves succession/maintainability.
counterevidence: WORK_LEDGER documents grader false positives, provider/tool/runtime failures and later tighter semantics.
resolution: Keep F2.6 as heuristic/test component, not scientific proof of succession.

claim: Merkle receipt proves the statement/effect is true and complete.
counterevidence: Integrity only proves chain/content integrity; completeness/truth require external observation/witness.
resolution: Separate integrity, statement truth, effect verification and completeness.

claim: Self-improvement is operationally demonstrated because Self-Build/Fitness code exists.
counterevidence: Fitness infrastructure/corpus exists but real solver measurement has provider/quota complications and sustained improvement is not demonstrated.
resolution: Require reproducible held-out longitudinal gains.

claim: All Atlas context should be copied into each agent session to prevent information loss.
counterevidence: Long-horizon context research and compaction failures motivate tiered context + external evidence retrieval + exact constraint preservation.
resolution: Use bounded ContextPackets and on-demand evidence.

claim: One agent per module is sufficient for autonomous maintenance.
counterevidence: Module boundaries may not match authority/evaluation boundaries; target is bounded subsystem + maintainer + contract + evaluator.
resolution: Derive bounded subsystems after Frontier Reconciliation.

claim: Per-agent monitoring is enough for the maintainer network.
counterevidence: Multi-Agent AI Control reports fragmentation effect under coordinated agents.
resolution: Add global network-level control monitor.

claim: A static universal memory write policy is sufficient for User Twin.
counterevidence: PerMemBench reports user-dependent storage value and open personalized gating challenge.
resolution: Research personalized write gating and calibration.

claim: CR-001 observed 334 missing docs-index paths (246 graveyard, 88 non-graveyard).
counterevidence: The unchanged auditor now observes 97 (9 graveyard, 88 non-graveyard) because 237 physical-tree graveyard artifacts are absent from the sealed tracked tree.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: The auditor prose says it gates every document.
counterevidence: Its suffix predicate also gates fixtures, schemas, and archived source/build metadata.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: The F2.6 automatic grade can be read as a capability score.
counterevidence: The preserved execution is FAIL 1/6 while measurement validity is independently INCONCLUSIVE due to a stale graph and missing semantic review.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: The 7341 Core bridge is read-only except for ADR-080's scoped Product OS routes.
counterevidence: Sealed server code exposes Mission approve/reject POST handlers that mutate ColdUpdate through the CLI outside that scope.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: Implementation registry says desktop-control admission is DONE with real E2E evidence.
counterevidence: The current ecosystem map calls it contradicted/quarantined; no external executable or computer_use lane was run here.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: ADC-WO-109 and tracked lineage consistently describe the current Code OSS baseline and implementation state.
counterevidence: The clean external checkout is 1.132.0/f7c27192 while tracked lineage identifies 1.129.1/8a7abeba; the work-order row also contains mutually incompatible current-state, compiled/running, pin-bump and retracted tsgo claims.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: F2.6 state and provider/Hermes reality are checkout-invariant at one commit.
counterevidence: The original checkout reported F2.6 due and env-backed Hermes; the isolated worktree without local state resolved different statuses against the same code/shared workspace.
resolution: PRESERVED; not resolved in FR-000/FR-001

claim: Operating invariant says every external effect is Merkle-audited.
counterevidence: API bridge design keeps its own EventStore, governance emergency log is separate, and some component audit calls are optional/best-effort.
resolution: Do not claim one fully enforced audit authority without end-to-end evidence.

claim: Catalog is described as machine source for curated MCPs.
counterevidence: User-adopted MCP config is a separate accepted authority merged at trunk creation.
resolution: Model catalog and adopted config as two authority planes.

claim: AuthBroker guarantees reference-only storage.
counterevidence: Process bootstrap includes plaintext .env parsing into memory.
resolution: Reference-only claim is correct only for AuthBroker persistence, not process-wide handling.
